headline: Weathered Front Holds as Central Battles Intensify
war_summary: The latest ledger shows no new strategic-base event in WeatheredExpanseHex during the past two hours, but its twenty-seven events in the day remain the war’s busiest record; the sector is now divided five Colonial holdings to four Warden. StonecradleHex has become more active than in the previous edition, reaching eleven daily events, with three in six hours and fighting rates accelerating sharply on both sides. DeadLandsHex also reports three events in the latest two hours, though casualty and enlistment rates are cooling from the earlier rush. LinnMercyHex remains a severe contested front, with thirteen daily events and three in six hours; both casualty streams are rising, particularly the Warden tally, while its ownership stands ten Colonial to one Warden. MooringCountyHex retains eleven daily events and renewed casualty acceleration, but no event has appeared in six hours. StlicanShelfHex is quieter after two events in six hours, while FishermansRowHex has gone still since its earlier burst of eight daily events. The remainder of the map shows little immediate base movement.
